legalMoves.description: Smyth's reward: take Ice Blast free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Evoker may spend 3 mana to give one unit −100 Init for the battle.
Smyth's reward: take Fiery Explosion free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Evoker may spend 3 mana to use its 2 DMG AoE spell.
Smyth's reward: take Mana Shield free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Evokers, Enchantresses, and Clerics may reduce an incoming hit's DMG at 1 mana per point.
Smyth's reward: take Dehance free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Enchantress may spend 2 mana to give one unit −1 DEF for the battle.
Smyth's reward: take Detection free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Enchantress may privately inspect an eligible opposing spy card during battle.

Smyth's reward: take Extra Build Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Build action card for the rest of the game (with Quartermaster's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target (ruling #87).

Smyth's reward: take Haste free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Each committed Surf produces two of its tile's resource. Surplus production from any purchase is banked and may pay later purchases this round, in full or in part; the bank empties at upkeep. The Economic spend still needs its full count of collectors on distinct tiles.
